title.zh: 手写 AdamW 与学习率调度
title.en: AdamW and the learning-rate schedule by hand

prompt.zh: 不使用 `torch.optim` 写出 AdamW 的一步更新，再实现带预热的余弦学习率调度。测试会连续 20 步与 `torch.optim.AdamW` 逐步对比，并验证第一步的更新量与梯度大小无关。
prompt.en: Write one AdamW update without `torch.optim` and implement the cosine learning-rate schedule with warm-up. The tests compare with `torch.optim.AdamW` step by step for 20 steps and verify that the first update does not depend on the size of the gradient.

hints.zh: 按函数说明中的五行公式的顺序逐行写即可。权重衰减先做，并且用的是更新前的参数。
hints.en: Write the five formulas of the docstring line by line in the given order. Weight decay comes first and uses the parameter before the update.

hints.zh: 不要原地修改输入的张量，用 `p = p - ...` 而不是 `p -= ...`。
hints.en: Do not modify the input tensors in place. Write `p = p - ...` and not `p -= ...`.

hints.zh: 学习率调度分三段，即预热、余弦下降和结束之后。先判断处在哪一段。
hints.en: The schedule has three parts, warm-up, cosine decay and after the end. First decide which part the step is in.
